## Before / after

For UI changes, drag screenshots into this description. GitHub stores them as user-attachments (`github.com/user-attachments/assets/...`), which keep working after the branch is deleted.

Do not point at images on the feature branch (a `blob/<branch>/` or `raw.githubusercontent.com` link whose ref is not `main`). Those 404 once the branch is deleted. The `docs-gates` check rejects them.
